newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $1.803 bln in May.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $1.803 bln in May.

text.p: Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange transactions showed a preliminary surplus of $1.803 billion in May in the forex commercial market, against a $1.351 billion surplus in April, bankers said Monday.

It was the highest surplus this year, partially due to the payment of some $1.1 billion for part of a controlling stake in state mining firm CVRD, which was sold at auction on May 6 by the Brazilian government. The winning consortium paid a total of $3.15 billion for the stake.
Also, dealers said some $800 million of the inflow was due to retail bank Unibanco's launch last week of global depositary receipts.
Financial buy deals totalled $7.484 billion in May, according to Central Bank data supplied to banks. Financial sell operations amounted to $5.767 billion.
Dealers said May contracted exports were $5.474 billion, and import operations totalled $5.388 billion.
